goal.insight: Show 3 parallel tracks (Research / Industry / Regulation) across 2010-2025 as a multi-track timeline
Research leads industry by 2-4 years, regulation lags industry by 3-5 years: Transformer (2017) to ChatGPT (2022) = 5.4yr, ChatGPT to EU AI Act (2024) = 1.3yr
ChatGPT (Nov 2022) compressed the multi-year lag to months — within 14 months: Biden EO, EU AI Act agreement, Bletchley Declaration all happened
More milestone events in 2023-2024 across all 3 tracks than in the entire 2010-2017 period
Overlay AI investment data: doubled from $48B (2022) to $96B (2024) in the 2 years following ChatGPT
